article.title: Conector чем… тем…
article.part: Subordinación y aspecto avanzado — Подчинение и продвинутый вид
article.chapter: Subordinación y conectores complejos — Подчинение и сложные союзы

claims.summary: Чем… тем… expresses correlation between degrees, with the main-clause degree determined by the subordinate degree.
The correlational structure has чем in the subordinate and тем in the related clause and uses comparative forms.
The correlated degrees may increase together or vary in opposing directions; the relationship is proportional rather than obligatorily positive.
The two cited examples instantiate comparative degree correlations.

locator.definition: degree in main clause is determined by degree in subordinate clause; comparatives in both components
examples: Чем свободнее человек, тем он богаче.
Чем дальше мы шли, тем лес становился темнее.
